node.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

action.description: The change; each action takes only its own fields

user.description: The INUBIT user whose active tag is set or removed; required for and only allowed with `setActiveTag` and `removeActiveTag`

tag.description: The tag, e.g. REL-2026-10-07; required for `setActiveTag`, `removeTag` and `deleteTag`

scope.description: Where `removeTag` and `deleteTag` act: one diagram group with its type, or one repository path; required for them (a call without it is refused with INVALID_INPUT before anything is read)

diagramType.description: The type of the diagram group; only a technical diagram group can be read for the preview

repositoryPath.description: A repository path below /Root; refused until the tagged repository files can be read for the backup

reason.description: Why the change is made, one line of 1 to 500 characters; stored in the audit log

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call, with the same inputs; executes the change
